requirements.statement: A user can sign in with their account so their todos are private to them

criteria.must: An unauthenticated visitor is directed to sign in before seeing any todo data
After signing in, a user only sees lists they own or collaborate on, not other users' private lists

requirements.statement: A user can create a todo list to organize related tasks together

criteria.must: A user can create a new list by providing a name
A newly created list appears in the user's list of lists

requirements.statement: A user can add a task to a list with a title, due date, priority, and categories/tags

criteria.must: A user can add a task to a list with a title
A task can be given a due date
A task can be given a priority
A task can be given one or more categories/tags

requirements.statement: A user can edit a task's details

criteria.must: A user can edit an existing task's title, due date, priority, or categories/tags
Edited task details are reflected when the task is viewed again

requirements.statement: A user can mark a task complete or incomplete to track progress

criteria.must: A user can mark an incomplete task as complete
A user can mark a complete task as incomplete

requirements.statement: A user can delete a task they no longer need

criteria.must: A user can delete a task from a list
A deleted task no longer appears in the list's tasks

requirements.statement: A user can filter and sort their tasks by due date, priority, or category/tag

criteria.must: A user can filter tasks by priority
A user can filter tasks by category/tag
A user can sort tasks by due date

requirements.statement: A user can invite another user to a shared list so they can manage tasks together

criteria.must: A list owner can invite another user to a list
The invited user gains access to the shared list once they accept

requirements.statement: A user can assign a task on a shared list to a specific collaborator

criteria.must: A user can assign a task on a shared list to a specific collaborator

requirements.statement: A user can see who a shared task is assigned to

criteria.must: The assignee of a shared task is visible to collaborators on the list

requirements.statement: A user can remove a collaborator from a shared list to control access

criteria.must: A list owner can remove a collaborator from a shared list
A removed collaborator no longer has access to the list

requirements.statement: A user can leave a shared list they were invited to

criteria.must: A collaborator can leave a shared list
A list the user has left no longer appears in their list of lists

requirements.statement: A user is notified in-app when invited to a list or assigned a task

criteria.must: A user receives an in-app notification when invited to a shared list
A user receives an in-app notification when assigned a task
